purpose: Prevent semantic collision between physical/geometric regime identifiers and scientific evidence-gate identifiers.
rules: Qualified identifiers are authoritative outside the native source contract.
REGIME:G* describes applicability/context, never evidence maturity.
SCI_GATE:G* describes evidence progression, never a physical regime.
An unqualified G* may be preserved only inside its original versioned source document.
A PASS in REGIME routing is not a PASS in SCI_GATE validation.
claim_boundary: Namespace reconciliation changes labels and routing clarity only; it does not promote scientific evidence.
